description: Texture statistics of real campfire/bonfire recordings (McDermott & Simoncelli 2011 style). Produced by tools/audio_analysis/texture_stats.py --build-reference references.json.

references.name: ref_dartington_crackling_fire
references.title: Dartington, Devon, UK - soundcamp2015dartington crackling fire (radio aporee)
references.author: TonyW
references.notes: Stereo, Vorbis 96 kbps source (16.5 kHz bandwidth). Clean, dense crackling wood fire, close mic. First 2 s (fade-in) excluded.

references.name: ref_commons_campfire_ambience
references.title: Campfire sound ambience.ogg (Wikimedia Commons, from Freesound)
references.author: Glaneur de sons
references.notes: Mono, Vorbis 86 kbps (18 kHz bandwidth). Small campfire, sparse loud crackles. Last 4 s (fade-out) excluded.

references.name: ref_wws_bonfire_burning
references.title: WWS Bonfireburning.ogg (Work With Sounds project, Werstas)
references.author: Work With Sounds / Werstas
references.notes: Stereo, Vorbis (15 kHz bandwidth). Large Finnish midsummer bonfire, strong roar, faint distant voices/birds in 1-4 kHz. 41-52 s (whistle at 8 kHz) excluded.

references.name: ref_heckfricker_campfire01
references.title: Campfire 01 (Freesound #729395, lossless mirror on archive.org)
references.author: HECKFRICKER
references.notes: Stereo 44.1 kHz/16-bit FLAC, full bandwidth. Quiet recording (-47 dBFS RMS) with audible recorder noise floor; sparse crackles.

references.name: ref_heckfricker_campfire02
references.title: Campfire 02 (Freesound #729396, lossless mirror on archive.org)
references.author: HECKFRICKER
references.notes: Stereo 44.1 kHz/16-bit FLAC, 268 s. Same recordist (probably same fire) as campfire01.

references.name: ref_kirchmoeser_campfire
references.title: Kirchmoeser Ost - campfire (radio aporee)
references.author: Udo Noll
references.notes: Stereo MP3 238 kbps (Sony PCM-D50 + Primo EM172). Small campfire on a cold autumn day, soft flame rumble, moderate crackles. MP3 dropout at ~119 s excluded.
